title: Endocrine System - Thyroid Gland and TSH Feedback
body:
Study the diagram of the hypothalamus-pituitary-thyroid axis:

```
[THYROID HORMONE REGULATION]

    +------------------+
    |   HYPOTHALAMUS   |
    +--------|---------+
             | Releases TRH
             | (Thyrotropin-Releasing Hormone)
             v
    +------------------+
    | PITUITARY GLAND  |
    | (Anterior lobe)  |
    +--------|---------+
             | Releases TSH
             | (Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone)
             v
    +------------------+
    |  THYROID GLAND   |
    +--------|---------+
             | Releases T3 and T4
             | (Thyroid hormones)
             v
    +------------------+
    |  TARGET CELLS    |
    | - Increase       |
    |   metabolic rate |
    +------------------+
             |
             | NEGATIVE FEEDBACK
             | (High T3/T4 inhibits TRH and TSH release)
             v
    <--------+--------->
       Back to Hypothalamus
       and Pituitary
```

A patient has an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism). Predict the levels of TSH in their blood and explain why using the concept of negative feedback.
